# Zebrafish Phenotype Ontology (ZP)

ZP is the ontology of phenotypes observed in zebrafish (_Danio rerio_). Its classes are generated from the phenotype annotations curated at [ZFIN](https://zfin.org), which are recorded there as post-composed Entity–Quality (EQ) statements, for example _somite border, somite 5_ + _amorphous_. ZP gives each distinct EQ statement a stable `ZP:` identifier, a label, a definition and a logical definition. That makes zebrafish phenotypes usable for cross-species work, for example in the [Monarch Initiative](https://monarchinitiative.org), in [uPheno](https://github.com/obophenotype/upheno) and in phenotype-driven disease gene prioritisation.

Most users do not need to edit anything in this repository: ZP content is driven by ZFIN curation, not by hand-editing.

## How ZP is built

1. **ZFIN data.** The pipeline downloads ZFIN's phenotype annotation files for a pinned archive day (`src/curation/zfin-lock.yaml`), so every build is reproducible.
2. **EQ keys and IDs.** Each annotation is reduced to a 7-part key (`entity-relation-parent-quality-entity2-relation2-parent2`). New keys get a fresh `ZP:` ID, which is recorded in `src/curation/id_map_zfin.tsv` and never reused.
3. **Design patterns.** Each key is assigned to a [DOSDP](https://github.com/INCATools/dead_simple_owl_design_patterns) pattern (`src/scripts/zp_dosdp.py`), and [dosdp-tools](https://github.com/INCATools/dosdp-tools) turns the pattern tables in `src/patterns/data/` into OWL axioms, labels and definitions.
4. **Alignment with uPheno.** Classes that also match one of the [uPheno patterns](https://github.com/obophenotype/upheno/tree/master/src/patterns/dosdp-patterns) are annotated with them, so ZP lines up with the phenotype ontologies of other species.
5. **Obsoletion.** EQ statements that ZFIN no longer uses are flagged as obsoletion candidates. A curator reviews them and moves them into `src/templates/obsolete.tsv`. ZP IDs are never deleted.
6. **Release.** The ontology is reasoned with ELK, checked with ROBOT and released through the [ODK](https://github.com/INCATools/ontology-development-kit).

Two GitHub Actions workflows run this process. [Update from ZFIN](.github/workflows/zfin-update.yml) pulls fresh ZFIN data, mints new IDs and opens a pull request. [Create release](.github/workflows/release.yml) builds the release files from `master` and attaches them to a draft GitHub release.

## Release files

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| [`zp.owl`](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/zp.owl), [`zp.obo`](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/zp.obo) | Main release: ZP classes with imported terms merged in, reasoned |
| [`zp-base.owl`](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/zp/zp-base.owl), `zp-base.obo` | Only the axioms ZP itself contributes, for reuse in other ontologies |
| [`zp-full.owl`](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/zp/zp-full.owl), `zp-full.obo` | Everything, including all imports and inferred axioms |
| `subsets/zapp.owl`, `.obo`, `.tsv` | The ZAPP subset of phenotypes used in the Zebrafish Toxicology Phenotype Atlas Project |
| `id_map.tsv`, `id_map_zfin.tsv` | Map from ZFIN EQ keys to ZP IDs |
| `fish_to_phenotype.tsv`, `genes_to_phenotype.tsv` | ZFIN annotations translated to ZP IDs |

The tables and the ZAPP subset are attached to each [GitHub release](https://github.com/obophenotype/zebrafish-phenotype-ontology/releases). A general description of ODK release files is in the [OBO Academy](https://oboacademy.github.io/obook/reference/release-artefacts/).

## Requesting changes

Most changes belong upstream: a wrong or missing phenotype usually means the ZFIN annotation or the anatomy term in [ZFA](https://github.com/ZFIN/zebrafish-anatomical-ontology) needs changing, and ZP picks it up on the next update. For problems with ZP itself (labels, definitions, logical definitions, obsoletions, the release files), please use the [issue tracker](https://github.com/obophenotype/zebrafish-phenotype-ontology/issues).

## Editors

- [ZP documentation](https://obophenotype.github.io/zebrafish-phenotype-ontology/)
- [Generic ODK workflows](src/ontology/README-editors.md)
- [OBO Academy oBook](https://oboacademy.github.io/obook/getting-started/): general documentation and tutorials for ontology editors and developers

To rebuild locally, run `sh zp_release.sh` from `src/ontology/`. It runs the same steps as the two workflows and needs Docker and the ODK image.

## Cite

A technical report describing ZP is being prepared for Zenodo; its DOI will be added here. Until then, please cite the repository and the uPheno paper, which describes the framework ZP is part of:

Matentzoglu N, Bello SM, Stefancsik R, _et al._ The Unified Phenotype Ontology: a framework for cross-species integrative phenomics. _Genetics_. 2025;229(3):iyaf027. DOI: [10.1093/genetics/iyaf027](https://doi.org/10.1093/genetics/iyaf027)
